basis: UPS’s April 25 earnings release was the earliest qualifying disclosure found. Reported consolidated revenue for the three months ended March 31, 2023 was $22,925 million versus $24,378 million a year earlier. That was $234.1 million below the $23,159.1 million threshold. The earlier revenue guidance covered the full year, and management’s quarterly guidance concerned operating profit.

coverage.detail: October 25, 2022, preceding earnings cycle. UPS reaffirmed consolidated revenue of around $102 billion for FY2022. The release gave no Q1 2023 revenue target.
January 31, 2023, Q4 2022 results. UPS forecast $97.0 billion to $99.4 billion of consolidated revenue for FY2023. The range supplied no Q1 revenue upper bound.
February 27 Form 8-K. UPS disclosed an underwriting agreement for $900 million and $1.1 billion of senior notes. Both amounts were debt principal.
March 7 Form 8-K. Item 7.01 directed investors to UPS’s IR presentations for conference materials. Item 8.01 covered a senior-note offering. The filing gave no quarterly sales figure.

March 7 Raymond James conference, slide 5. UPS explicitly carried forward its January 31 call outlook without an update. The $97.0 billion to $99.4 billion range still covered FY2023. The roughly 44%/56% split, and the similar split discussed for Q1 and Q2 on the January call, applied to adjusted operating profit.
April 11 notice. UPS scheduled the results for approximately 6:00 a.m. Eastern on April 25. The notice contained no preliminary results or updated revenue guidance.
April 25, Exhibit 99.2. The first-quarter income statement schedule gives total revenue of $22,925 million and $24,378 million for 2023 and 2022, respectively, a reported 6.0% decline.

The subsequent 10-Q confirms the reporting perimeter. Q1 2023 Supply Chain Solutions included Bomi Group following its November 2022 acquisition. The comparison uses UPS’s reported consolidated totals for each period, with no pro forma adjustment to Q1 2022.

publication_date_evidence: The UPS investor-relations release explicitly states “Released April 25, 2023.” Its April 11 scheduling notice independently identifies April 25 as the public results date.
